title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP07b-auth — delete and change-trusted-base authorizations for the engine and binding separation
goal: Add the delete and change-trusted-base authorizations that the CP07b change PR will consume, without changing any trusted component or registered policy.
acceptanceCriteria: A delete record binds the base tree entry of the engine file that holds the IFX gate rules, and a change-trusted-base record covers the package-local locks, the architecture conformance engine, the runner, the architecture conformance tests and the package tests.
The change-trusted-base parity contract states that the composite policy hash, the report fields, the twelve policy bindings, the tool version and the command line and MCP contracts stay unchanged.
No trusted component or registered policy changes, nothing is deleted, and all 13 required checks pass.
